preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= n <= 500 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For every test case, n is between 5 and 500 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 500.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in row) and len(set(row)) == n for row in all_arrays)
preconditions.description: Every array in the input is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.
Each test case contains exactly 2n arrays.

preconditions.expression: all(arr1 != arr2 for i, arr1 in enumerate(all_arrays) for j, arr2 in enumerate(all_arrays) if i < j)
preconditions.description: No two arrays in the input are completely equal.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(count_line) % 998244353 == int(count_line) for count_line in output_lines[::2])
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case output is an integer representing the count modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(len(indices) == n and all(1 <= idx <= 2*n for idx in indices) for indices in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines[1::2]])
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case output contains exactly n distinct indices between 1 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len({selected_arrays[i][col] for i in range(n)}) == n for col in range(n)) for selected_arrays in [ [all_arrays[idx-1] for idx in indices] for indices in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines[1::2]]])
postconditions.description: The selected arrays for each test case form a Latin square: for every column position, the elements from the selected arrays are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(int(count_line) == (count_good_subsets % 998244353) for count_line, count_good_subsets in zip(output_lines[::2], [sum(1 for subset in all_subsets_of_size_n if is_latin_square(subset)) for all_subsets_of_size_n in [get_all_subsets(all_arrays, n)] for is_latin_square in [lambda s: all(len({s[i][col] for i in range(n)}) == n for col in range(n))]])
postconditions.description: The printed count equals the total number of good subsets (subsets of size n forming a Latin square) modulo 998244353.
